author: technews
text: BREAKING: OpenChip announces the Photon-1, the first consumer laptop chip built on a 1.4nm process. Claims 2x battery life over anything shipping today.

author: chipanalyst
text: Photon-1 benchmarks leaked: 30% faster single core than last year's flagship, but yields are reportedly terrible. Don't expect volume until Q2 next year.

author: laptopreviewer
text: Hands-on with a Photon-1 dev unit. It's real, it's fast, and it ran a full compile of Chromium without spinning up the fans once. Wild.

author: hoopswire
text: FINAL: Meteors 112, Comets 108 in double OT. Jalen Cruz drops a career-high 51 points. Series tied 3-3, game 7 Thursday night.

author: courtsidereport
text: Cruz after the game: 'We weren't losing this one at home.' Meteors coach confirms Okafor is questionable for game 7 with an ankle sprain.

author: marketminute
text: Fed minutes out: two more members now leaning toward a September rate cut. Futures immediately priced in 70% odds, up from 45% yesterday.

author: bondtrader
text: 10-year yield down 12bps on the Fed minutes. Biggest one-day move since March. Everyone repositioning for the cut.

author: spacedaily
text: The Artemis IV crew just completed their final dress rehearsal. Launch window opens July 14. This is the mission that assembles the first lunar surface habitat module.

author: rocketwatch
text: Weather odds for the July 14 Artemis IV window just moved to 80% favorable. Backup windows July 16 and 19.

author: devgossip
text: The maintainer of leftfill (npm package with 40M weekly downloads) just deprecated it with the message 'use String.prototype.padStart, it's been ten years.' Half of CI worldwide is now printing warnings.

author: jsframework
text: Follow-up: leftfill deprecation broke exactly zero builds but generated an estimated 4 billion warning lines in 24 hours. The maintainer says he regrets nothing.

author: weatherdesk
text: Heat advisory extended through Friday for the entire northeast corridor. Highs near 38C. Utilities asking people to shift laundry and dishwashing to after 9pm.
